=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:57-60 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The external-PR slug `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` drops the owner and changes every non-alphanumeric character to `-`, and the lookup resumes a matching `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` without checking its `- Reference:` line. So two different PRs (e.g. alice/tool#37 and bob/tool#37, or owner/foo.bar#37 and owner/foo-bar#37) can resume the same log. The same logic is in the live copy .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md at lines 50-53.
  WHY: Running `/deploy-activate` for the second PR resumes the first PR's log, treats its `[x]` steps as done, and may report LIVE without activating the second project. Reviewers disagreed on severity: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT (it notes the owner-less naming is what #7650 asks for, and calls the missing Reference check the defect), openai_gpt-6-luna and qwen_qwen3_7-plus said MAJOR, and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said BLOCKER. The highest is used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:71 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Activation Log file-format template still shows "- Reference: <#1234 / URL / plan path / feature>" (live copy .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:64). Under the new lookup, a bare `#N` reference is ambiguous: a legacy `pr-<N>.md` is resumed for an external PR only when it names `owner/repo#N` or the PR URL.
  WHY: Logs written from this template with `- Reference: #37` will not match, so the command starts a fresh `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` and the operator repeats steps already done. This fails safe, but new logs keep carrying the ambiguity.
- docs/deploy-activation/README.md:10-11 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The README still documents the single old rule "- PR → `pr-<N>.md`", which contradicts the new `pr-<repo>-<N>` rule for external PRs in both command copies.
  WHY: This is a documentation defect only, because the command text is authoritative. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes the file is outside the PR's `files_touched` grant, so it can only be fixed in a follow-up.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The slug and lookup rules were updated, but the Activation Log template example (`- Reference: <#1234 / URL / plan path / feature>`) was not, which causes the ambiguity in the ERROR PATHS finding.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (the live copy .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md has the same logic at lines 50-53) lines 57-60 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Two different external PRs can produce the same file name (alice/tool#37 vs bob/tool#37, owner/foo.bar#37 vs owner/foo-bar#37 → `pr-tool-37.md` / `pr-foo-bar-37.md`). The lookup resumes a matching `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` without checking `- Reference:`, a check it already makes for the legacy `pr-<N>.md` form.
  WHY: Running the command for the second PR resumes the first PR's log, treats its `[x]` steps as done, and may report LIVE without activating the second project. The owner-less naming is to spec per #7650; the missing Reference check is the defect. The fix is about one sentence per copy.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:71 (live copy .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:64) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The template line "- Reference: <#1234 / URL / plan path / feature>   (+ any secondary refs)" still shows the bare `#1234` form, which is ambiguous under the new rule (a legacy `pr-<N>.md` is resumed for an external PR only if it names `owner/repo#N` or the URL).
  WHY: An older external-PR log with `- Reference: #37` is ignored and a fresh `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` is started, so steps are repeated. This fails safe and does not affect the `pr-mongo-explorer-37.md` case. New logs can keep recording `#N`.
- docs/deploy-activation/README.md lines 10-11, "- PR → `pr-<N>.md`" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README still gives a single PR rule, which contradicts the new `pr-<repo>-<N>` rule for external PRs.
  WHY: No runtime break, because the command text is authoritative. The file is outside the PR's `files_touched` grant, so this is a follow-up only.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The reviewer checked against #7650: both copies have the new slug rule with the `pr-mongo-explorer-37` example, the "Look up before creating" rule, and the "Never rename or move an existing log" clause. Issue, plan-doc and feature slugs are unchanged. Step 1 points to the lookup. The test `test_activation_log_slug_handles_prs_in_other_repositories` pins the shared wording. The changelog fragment `changelog.d/7650-deploy-activate-cross-repo-pr-slug.md` is present with a `changed` marker. The negative assertion `"PR → `pr-<N>` ·" not in section` holds for both copies.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): (1) In the "Look up before creating" bullet of both copies, add "Resume a `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` log only when its `- Reference:` line names that PR; if it names a different owner or repository, stop and ask before creating or overwriting a log." (1 line per copy). (2) At workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:71 and .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:64, change the line to "- Reference: <#1234 / owner/repo#N for a PR in another repository / URL / plan path / feature>" (1 line per copy). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (and .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md) Line: 58-60 (and 51-53) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The external-PR slug kebab-cases only the bare repository name (`owner/foo.bar` -> `foo-bar`), and the activation log lookup is not scoped to the specific repository.
  WHY: Repos that both have PR `37` and the same kebab-cased name resolve to the same `pr-foo-bar-37.md`, so the second project resumes the first project's log and may skip critical setup steps.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md (and .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md) Line: 71 (and 64) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Activation Log file-format template still suggests the bare `#1234` format for `- Reference:`.
  WHY: The new lookup resumes an existing `pr-<N>.md` for an external PR only if `- Reference:` contains `owner/repo#N` or the PR URL. With the old format the lookup misses, a new log is created, and the operator repeats completed steps.
- docs/deploy-activation/README.md Line: 10-11 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README still documents the old single PR rule "- PR → `pr-<N>.md`".
  WHY: Documentation defect that contradicts the updated `pr-<N>.md` / `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` rules and misleads operators. Not a runtime break.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Make the same edit in both copies of `deploy-activate.md`, and leave every other step unchanged."
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md
  Evidence of absence: The slug and lookup rules were updated, but the Activation Log template example (`- Reference: <#1234 / URL / plan path / feature>`) was not, which leads to the ambiguity in the ERROR PATHS lens.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md; same logic in .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md — Template lines 57–60; live copy lines 50–53 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: External PR slugs use only the repository name and PR number, and the lookup resumes a matching `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` without checking its `- Reference:` line.
  WHY: `owner-a/api#37` and `owner-b/api#37` both map to `pr-api-37.md`, so running the command for the second PR resumes the first PR's log and may skip steps for the wrong project.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:60 (same logic at .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:53) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The lookup checks the `- Reference:` line of a `pr-<N>.md` candidate for an external PR but not of a `pr-<repo>-<N>.md` candidate. Because the owner is dropped and non-alphanumerics are normalized, `alice/foo#37` and `bob/foo#37` (or `alice/foo.bar#37` and `alice/foo-bar#37`) collide.
  WHY: The model finds the existing file and resumes from the first unchecked step even though the log belongs to a different PR, so `[x]` steps from the first PR are skipped for the second.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
